chunks: Who made all things He created excellent; and first fashioned man from clay,
ai.seo_question: What is the origin of human creation according to Surah As-Sajdah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine wisdom (Hikmah) behind the material origin of humans, linking the physical form created from clay to the subsequent infusion of the divine spirit. It serves as a foundational argument for the unity of the physical and spiritual dimensions of human nature, emphasizing that the perfection of creation reflects Allah's attribute of Al-Muhsin (The Doer of Good).
